name: Investor wall of love
purpose: A single full-bleed horizontally-scrolling row of tinted quote cards with text filters beneath. Appears on both the homepage and /about with identical content.

motion.detail: Filtering keeps EVERY card mounted and animates width, margin-right and opacity to 0 for hidden cards (150ms ease-out each) rather than removing them from the DOM.

layoutNote: A single flex-nowrap row bled to 100vw via a negative margin — NOT a wrapping masonry grid.
assetPolicy: Every card's logo slot uses decor.logo-placeholder, a generic glyph. Real investor firm logos must never be substituted.
